skills_delete_confirm_description: {name} is removed from the library and unassigned from every Agent; their Computers stop syncing it. This cannot be undone.
skills_delete_failed: The skill could not be deleted.
skills_empty_detail: Upload a zip archive with a SKILL.md at its root, then assign it to Agents from each Agent's Skills page.
skills_error_invalid_archive: The archive is not a valid skill. Check that SKILL.md sits at the root with name and description frontmatter.
skills_error_storage_unavailable: Skill storage is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
skills_error_too_large: The Server refused the archive because it is larger than {limit}.
skills_error_unsupported_type: The Server only accepts application/zip archives.
skills_markdown_no_agents: Not assigned to any Agent yet.
skills_page_description: Reusable playbooks that give Agents the context and methods they need to do specialized work.
skills_upload_conflict_description: A skill with the same name as {file} already exists. Replacing it updates every Agent it is assigned to.
skills_upload_drop_hint: Drop a .zip archive anywhere on the list to upload it.
skills_upload_failed: The skill could not be uploaded.
skills_upload_too_large: {file} is larger than {limit}. Skill archives must be {limit} or smaller.
skills_upload_trust_warning: Only upload skills from sources you trust: their instructions and scripts run inside your Agents.
